notes: Q4 IS from the Q4 earnings release three-month block; release IS has no dividends-declared line, so dps_declared is null (release CF shows cash dividends PAID per share; see release.extra).
IS 'lines' include the release's 'Effective tax rate' (%) and weighted average share rows as printed.

adjusted_roic_pct = the release's 'Return on invested capital' (rolling 12 months; LECO defines it as rolling-12-month Adjusted net income before tax-effected interest income/expense divided by invested capital, i.e. computed on an adjusted basis). No GAAP-basis ROIC published, so roic_reported_pct null.

IS: equity earnings in affiliates are not shown separately on the income statement (included in 'Other income (expense)'); equity_earnings and interest_income null; interest_expense is 'Interest expense, net' (interest_expense_is_net true).
Segment EBIT, sales change and non-GAAP figures are the three-month Q4 columns of the Q4 release.

cash_conversion_pct 150 from release highlights ('Q4 Cash flow from operations increases 23.3% to $123 million and achieved 150% cash conversion'); Cash conversion is defined as Net cash provided by operating activities less Capital expenditures divided by Adjusted net income. Free cash flow not published as a number (null).
Q4 dividends declared per share not printed for the quarter; derivable as FY declared 1.9 (10-K) minus nine-month declared 1.41 (Q3 10-Q) = 0.49 (derived, NOT filled in dps_declared).
